description: This Java class defines a strategy for handling PolicyIdModified events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides a method to update a ThingBuilder with a new policy ID from the event.

classes.name: PolicyIdModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final strategy class that handles PolicyIdModified events by updating a ThingBuilder with the new policy ID.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the method to apply a PolicyIdModified event to a ThingBuilder, setting the policy ID based on the event's data.
